lines: Even in ordinary practice: the making
of the desired form of body and the rest as
other forms' absence — that alone is practice's
l4.sanskrit_cite: laukike 'pi vā abhyāse cidātmatvena sarvarūpasya tasya tasya dehādeḥ abhimatarūpatāprakaṭīkaraṇaṃ taditararūpanyagbhāvanaṃ ca iti eṣa eva abhyāsārthaḥ

reads_against.argmap: What is the meaning of abhyāsa even in the laukika? → Laukika-abhyāsa = cid-ātmatā-manifestation + anya-rūpa-nyāga — same structure, ordinary content.
c1_essence: Laukika-abhyāsa = cid-ātmatā manifestation + other-form absence — that is its purpose.
reads_against.c1_rasa: karuṇā with vīrya weight (compassion carrying fierce argument)
